The Best Pizza & Subs At The Beach Since 1998!

Crico's Pizza and Subs in Gulf Shores, AL, is a beloved local eatery renowned for its delicious pizzas and mouthwatering subs. Nestled in the heart of Gulf Shores, this cozy establishment offers a welcoming atmosphere where patrons can enjoy freshly prepared meals with friends and family.

﻿

From traditional pepperoni pizzas to specialty pies loaded with gourmet toppings, Crico's caters to every pizza lover's cravings. Their subs are equally tantalizing, with a variety of options ranging from classic Italian combos to hearty meatball subs. With friendly service and quality ingredients, Crico's Pizza and Subs is a must-visit destination for both locals and tourists craving authentic and satisfying meal on the Alabama Gulf Coast.




Call (251) 948-3100 to place your pickup or delivery order today!

Menu
Customer Testimonials

Good food! Friendly staff!
The pizza crust is well done but not burnt, the cheese is perfect and the sauce is mild. It's a good bite of pizza.
Also ordered the Italian sub and the beef and cheese sub. Both were prepared perfectly. You can really tell these guys know what they're doing!
Worth the stop!

Joe Noga

I had a sandwich delivered and completely forgot to get a receipt for work. So the next day I went to get a copy and had another sandwich since the previous one was absolutely fantastic! A gentleman dug through receipts and found it for me. Their food is top notch, but somehow their service is even better!! This will be a “must visit” restaurant every time I’m in town.

Eric Staley

We ordered for carryout while on vacation. The man on the phone estimated 35 minutes until it would be ready. We got there about 30 minutes after and it was just finishing up. Everyone was friendly and helpful throughout the ordering and pick up process.
We got the all meat pizza and the Buffalo chicken pizza + bacon and jalapeños. Both were delicious, but everyone especially loved the Buffalo chicken. We look forward to eating here again when we visit Gulf Shores.

Jonae Mitzel
